body:
Subject: URGENT for every wave from now on — BUG-1275: the CI idle window trips on HEALTHY runs since BUG-1250 landed

Live at 17:46: BUG-1268 / PR #1970 shelved "ci-unavailable: CI idle for 600s with no progress" while its run 35458563676 was perfectly healthy — created and started 17:35:31, still in_progress at 17:46:39. GitHub was not rate limited (core 5000/5000). Nothing was wrong except that the build took longer than ten minutes.

Why this hits every wave: the idle window defaults to 600s and this repo's PR CI median is 9-10 minutes (CLAUDE.md, 23 runs). A large share of all runs will now trip it, each costing a shelve plus a full re-drive.

Why now: while a required check sits pending or in_progress the GitHub rollup fingerprint does not change, so the idle clock never re-arms — the same defect BUG-1224 fixed for GitLab and never fixed for GitHub. Before BUG-1250 this was invisible because NoSignal simply proceeded without a gate. BUG-1250 correctly made it shelve. The trade is right; the window is now wrong. This is an interaction between two correct fixes, not a defect in either.

Filed BUG-1275, high, Draft, referencing both BUG-1224 and BUG-1250. Shape: treat a required check in a non-terminal state as progress and re-arm the clock; keep the absolute ceiling as the real backstop; and set the default window above measured CI p95 rather than near the median.

Mitigation already applied on my side: the standing launcher now exports AIDA_WORKER_CI_IDLE=2400 for every wave it starts, so waves keep moving until the fix lands. Any wave YOU start by hand needs the same, or it will shelve healthy work.

BUG-1268 itself is Done with its PR open and CI still running; it needs no code, only a re-drive once its check goes green.
